questions.cardText:
[Medical Sciences] What is the primary difference between micronutrients and macronutrients?
A. Macronutrients provide energy, while micronutrients do not
B. Micronutrients are only found in fruits and vegetables, while macronutrients are found in all food groups
C. Macronutrients are required in larger quantities than micronutrients
Answer: C. Macronutrients, including carbohydrates, proteins, and fats, are needed in larger quantities for energy and growth. Micronutrients, such as vitamins and minerals, are essential but required in smaller amounts.
questions.de: Wie nennt man Nährstoffe wie Kohlenhydrate, Proteine und Fette, die der Körper in größeren Mengen benötigt als Vitamine und Mineralstoffe?
questions.en: What are the nutrients such as carbohydrates, proteins and fats called, which the body needs in larger quantities than vitamins and minerals?

timeline.labelEn: William Prout classifies food substances into the groups later called carbohydrates, fats and proteins
timeline.labelDe: William Prout teilt Nahrungsstoffe in die später Kohlenhydrate, Fette und Proteine genannten Gruppen ein

questions.notes: Wikipedia: macronutrients are consumed in grams, micronutrients in milligrams or micrograms; it also counts water among macronutrients. Timeline from the William Prout article.

questions.cardText:
[Philosophy] Who is known for the phrase “I think, therefore I am”?
A. Nietzsche B. Socrates C. Descartes
Answer: C.
questions.de: Welcher Philosoph ist für den Satz „Ich denke, also bin ich“ bekannt?
questions.en: Which philosopher is known for the phrase “I think, therefore I am”?

timeline.labelEn: Descartes publishes “je pense, donc je suis” in his Discourse on the Method
timeline.labelDe: Descartes veröffentlicht „je pense, donc je suis“ in seinem „Discours de la méthode“
